subject: Emotions
title: EQ in Leadership
description: A quick win: understand EQ in Leadership.

hook.text: Google studied its best managers. Technical skill ranked last. The top qualities were emotional: empathy and coaching.

buildup.text: Google's Project Oxygen found the best managers listen, show empathy, and care about their team's wellbeing.

discovery.text: Emotional intelligence explains why some leaders inspire loyalty while equally smart leaders create toxic environments.

twist.text: High-EQ leaders don't avoid hard conversations. They deliver tough feedback with enough empathy that people can hear it.

climax.text: Teams with emotionally intelligent leaders show 20% higher engagement and 21% greater profitability in Gallup data.

punchline.text: The best leaders don't manage tasks. They manage emotions.

quiz.question: What did Google's Project Oxygen find about top managers?
options: EQ qualities like empathy ranked highest
